capabilities: host a vault subfolder as a static file server on a chosen port
configure folders and ports in the plugin settings
serve vault files to other applications
extras: The README is brief and ends with an unanswered FAQ item about viewing the demo site; setup is explained only as a short step list with one iframe example.
problem: Obsidian cannot serve vault files over HTTP, so embedded websites that need a server or that fail from CORS restrictions do not display offline.
summary: Local static file server that hosts vault subfolders over HTTP so their files can be shown in iframes or opened from other applications.
